scope: A source-verified sweep of major emulator projects for home consoles, handhelds, arcade hardware, and personal computers. Includes standalone emulators, multi-system emulators, and significant emulator cores. Repeated entries for one emulator are merged. Because this field is open-ended, the inventory describes broad verified coverage and cannot guarantee every emulator ever released.
